class.name: SteamWorkshopItem
class.brief_description: Detached metadata for one Steam Workshop item.

method.name: get_author_steam_id
method.description: The Workshop author's unsigned decimal SteamID64. An empty string indicates that Steam supplied no author.

method.name: get_description
method.description: The description copied from Steam while the query was live.

method.name: get_published_id
method.description: The exact published file ID as a canonical unsigned decimal string.

method.name: get_title
method.description: The Workshop title reported by Steam.
